items.title: Add material-overlap audit to Authority gate request contracts
items.context: Update GateEvaluateRequestContract and schema with a typed materialOverlapAudit containing changedFiles and actualFileOverlaps. Keep the field explicit and narrow; do not add new /v1/checks or /v1/commands contracts.
items.userSees: GateEvaluateRequestContract and schema accept a typed materialOverlapAudit with changedFiles and actualFileOverlaps for /v1/gates/evaluate, without adding new /v1/checks or /v1/commands contracts.

happy.desc: Parse a GateEvaluateRequestContract for targetPhase=DONE with materialOverlapAudit.changedFiles=[] and materialOverlapAudit.actualFileOverlaps=[] -> schema accepts it and the parsed request retains both arrays; WHY: proves schema acceptance for the required empty no-overlap audit shape from docs/requirements/decisions/authority-done-material-overlap-audit-cli-fix.md.

edge.desc: Parse a gate request whose materialOverlapAudit.changedFiles contains concrete repo paths while actualFileOverlaps is empty -> both arrays remain present and unchanged; WHY: changed-file evidence must not be dropped when there are no overlaps.

adversarial.desc: Submit malformed materialOverlapAudit values such as missing actualFileOverlaps or non-array changedFiles -> contract validation rejects or fails before signing; WHY: the field must stay explicit and narrow instead of becoming a loose passthrough blob.

items.title: Include material-overlap audit in signed DONE gate envelopes
items.context: Ensure buildGateEvaluateEnvelope places decision.materialOverlapAudit inside the decision payload before signHexEnvelope. The general Authority gate path must preserve non-empty actualFileOverlaps rather than clearing them.

items.title: Update live Python E2E smoke DONE preflight
items.context: authority-live-python-e2e-smoke must submit a minimal empty materialOverlapAudit for the no-overlap staging smoke so DONE preflight no longer fails with present=false.

items.title: Add regression coverage and rebuild CLI
items.context: Cover schema acceptance, envelope inclusion before signing, live smoke request shape, and preservation of non-empty overlaps. Rebuild packages/main/dist after source changes.

items.title: Run targeted validation and record evidence
items.context: Run the targeted tests/build and, if staging credentials are available, the Authority live smoke against https://staging.hostneutral.net. Record exact evidence and any remaining external blocker.
